evidenceType: Actual macOS Flutter rendering through fixed loopback relays to actual emulated Linux backend, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Auth/Firestore emulators; synthetic local workload only.

resultIdentity.scoreFinder: 3 successful observations each per mode; no ordered-membership digest for these flows, so no stronger identical-membership claim from timing JSON.

counterMeaning: Instrumented method calls and requested document counts, not billed Firestore reads. Query-returned rows are excluded from requestedDocuments.
Unique document counts are per endpoint; do not sum as global distinct reads.
Nested and concurrent operation durations overlap; summing them is not request wall time.
Both modes retain 26 membership queries and 191 instrumented SQL queries per guest sample; reduced challenge round trips do not imply SQL authority replacement.
limitations: First observations are retained separately and are not proof of a cold-start distribution.
19 warm guest samples per mode: window 18/19 at or below 2 seconds; one 2225.986ms sample. No consistent sub-2-second or hosted-tail claim.
Linux x64 runs under Rosetta on this Mac; Flutter is on macOS. No native cloud CPU, network, mobile-device or nationwide load qualification.
Serial and window runs are sequential fixed-fixture runs; do not infer a general causal latency distribution from these samples.
Signed, Score and Finder remain functional; their timings are not claimed unchanged or improved.
